entries.en: condemned to death; sentenced to death
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅「因」一字，与音写 fū ī jū（M）、chein（R）均不能对合，疑原件脱文，释义依西语词头定夺。

entries.zh: 判处三年徒役（解送充军服苦役三年）
entries.en: sentenced to three years' penal servitude; condemned to serve three years as a military convict

entries.zh: 判处流放服苦役（流徒刑）
entries.en: sentenced to exile with penal servitude; condemned to hard labour in exile
sentenced to penal servitude; dispatched to hard labour as a convict
to sentence to death; to condemn to death
to sentence to whipping; to condemn to lashes with a leather whip

entries.zh: 依判决定罪；判罪（准以财物赎刑）
entries.en: to convict by sentence; to condemn by judgment (with redemption of the penalty by payment)
entries.notes: 「贖」指赎刑，与 sentencia 词头仅部分对应，M 栏末音污损，取定罪判决之义。

entries.zh: 判处站刑（发往驿站枷示充役）
entries.en: to sentence to the post-station penalty (cangue and hard labour at a relay station)
entries.notes: 擺站为明代徒刑之一，发驿充役，与 galera 之强制苦役义近而非等同。

entries.zh: 判处充船役（发往桨船服苦役）
entries.en: to sentence to the galleys
entries.notes: 「軋船」於 galeras 义费解，音写 vār/chuñ 亦不明，疑为押船或划船之讹。

entries.zh: 判处终身充军（终身当兵）
entries.en: to condemn to perpetual military service; to sentence to be a soldier for life
a prisoner condemned to death; one under sentence of death
entries.notes: 音写 fū（M）与 chêñ（R）均与「囚」常音不合，唯汉字栏清晰，据字定夺。

entries.en: convicted person; one found guilty
entries.notes: 汉字栏存疑（犯罪/紀罪），取「犯罪」，依西语 culpado 补足为「被定罪者」。

entries.en: natural temperament; natural constitution
innate nature; natural disposition
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节残缺（sīm fē:），疑「心性」之残；H「性」与 R sēng 自足。

entries.en: condition; state; disposition

entries.zh: 性情强悍凶暴；脾气倔强
entries.en: fierce and violent disposition; a terrible, obstinate temper
entries.notes: 音写 guīo（M）、quàng（R）与「強」常音不合，取強橫之义以合 terrible。

entries.en: wild and savage disposition; mad temper
good and well-disposed nature; gentle disposition
entries.notes: 汉字栏存疑（閏/潤），就 condición buena 与音写 xūn 推为「順」之讹。

entries.en: mind and nature; innate disposition
temper; temperament; disposition

entries.zh: 脾气坏，动辄发怒；性情执拗暴躁
entries.en: bad disposition, quick to anger; obstinate and irascible temper
entries.notes: 汉字栏存疑（拗怒/拘怒），取「拗怒」以合 se enoja 之易怒义。
